selection_policy: Annotation-only. First available 160 consecutive native frames. Require >=80 strict small object-frames. Deduplicate source prefix with lexicographically first eligible sequence. Dominant category group by strict annotation counts, tie order road/ship/air. random.Random(46), sample in fixed group order. Train 4 road/2 ship/2 air; calibration 1 road/1 ship; confirmation 2 road/1 ship/1 air. No prediction used.
label_protocol: Explicit weak bounding-box supervision, not author-generated Gaussian segmentation masks.
independence_limit: Source-prefix disjointness from all official training prefixes and previously developed clips; physical scene independence still needs image inspection.
